description: PREFER for HISTORICAL closing prices and daily returns on a specific past date or date range — "what did the S&P 500 close at on August 7", "closing prices and daily returns for these four indices last Friday", "AAPL close on 2026-06-30". Accepts one or more Yahoo Finance symbols (indices ^GSPC/^IXIC/^DJI/^SOX/^RUT, stocks, ^TNX yields, GC=F commodities, BTC-USD crypto, EURUSD=X FX — same symbol space as get_quotes) plus start_date/end_date, and returns each trading day's close WITH the previous close and the computed daily return percent, per symbol. Covers shares listed on exchanges worldwide through the Yahoo exchange suffix — EL.PA (EssilorLuxottica, Euronext Paris), FME.DE (Fresenius Medical Care, Xetra), RED.MC (Redeia, Bolsa de Madrid), EVO.ST (Evolution, Nasdaq Stockholm), ENI.MI, ASML.AS, NESN.SW, NOVO-B.CO, HSBA.L (London), 7203.T (Toyota, Tokyo), 0700.HK, 005930.KS, 2330.TW, BHP.AX, RELIANCE.NS, SHOP.TO, PETR4.SA — each result carries its currency and exchange; "last 6 daily closes of EssilorLuxottica on Euronext Paris" is one call. Also accepts an ISIN in place of a symbol (e.g. FR0000121667, DK0062498333): it is matched to the exchange listing and the row says which listing was chosen (resolved_from_isin, symbol, exchange, currency). An ISIN that trades on several exchanges needs the optional exchange argument (".DE", "Xetra"); without it the tool returns the candidate listings instead of choosing. Company names are not looked up. Keyless (Yahoo Finance). Use get_quotes for CURRENT prices; this tool is for any date in the past.

end_date.description: Last date wanted, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to start_date.

exchange.description: Only used when a symbol is an ISIN that trades on several exchanges: a suffix such as ".DE" / ".PA" or an exchange name such as "Xetra" picks the listing. Without it, an ISIN with several listings returns the candidate listings (symbol, exchange, currency, name) and no prices.

start_date.description: First date wanted, YYYY-MM-DD. For a single day, set start_date = end_date — the previous close and daily return for that day are included automatically.

symbols.description: One or more Yahoo Finance symbols, e.g. "^GSPC" or ["^GSPC","^IXIC","^DJI","^SOX"]. Comma-separated string also accepted. Up to 40 per call — symbols beyond that come back in "dropped_symbols", never silently.

name: price_history

outputSchema.description: Daily closes and returns per symbol. A symbol may be an ISIN: it is matched to its exchange listing; with several listings and no exchange hint the row has found:false and candidates.

candidates.description: Listings to choose from when an ISIN has several (or the hint matched none)

empty_reason.description: Why an ISIN produced no price

resolution_note.description: Which listing the ISIN was matched to and why

resolved_from_isin.description: Present when the symbol asked for was an ISIN: the ISIN as given

symbol.description: The listing symbol priced (for an ISIN, the resolved one); the ISIN itself when it could not be resolved

title: Price History
